findings.reason: The Definition treats A² integrable as sufficient for the variance formula and square-integrable A,B as sufficient for covariance, but does not supply or prove L²-to-L¹ integrability and integrability of the product. The smallest missing supplier is the published cor-cauchy-schwarz-inequality-for-l-two, which states ∫|fg| ≤ ||f||₂||g||₂.

Proof step 2.1 invokes Cauchy–Schwarz to infer a finite first absolute Gaussian moment, but the theorem's deps omit cor-cauchy-schwarz-inequality-for-l-two and the proof gives no local alternative. Also, U_C is only called measurable on C_N while the phase reference is Borel and the canonical preparation requires a measurable Hamiltonian on Γ_N; specify Borel measurability or a completed-reference/Borel-version convention.
